homepage.body:
Mendeley | Homepage
The free all-in-one reference manager
Mendeley helps you stay organized, do more in less time, and bring ease to your research workflow.
  • Enjoy 2GB of free storage
  • Advanced knowledge at speed
  • Trusted by millions of researchers
Download for
orGet started on Mendeley Web
Opens in a new window
Also try LeapSpace, your AI research companionExplore literature, find funding, spark ideas and plan your next project.
Reference management made simpleAdd PDFs to your library in seconds, organize with collections and tags, then read, highlight and annotate — all from one place.
LeapSpace
Let AI connect the dotsUncover patterns, relationships and missing links across your references — quickly.AI in Mendeley interprets the logic behind your queries, pulling context-rich insights from your documents.

From first addition to final submission

Because behind every great discovery is a well-managed library
Stay informed with our latest news
How to Take Full Advantage of Mendeley Before the Year EndsAs the year winds down, many academics find themselves taking stock of unfinished projects. And often, a chaotic reference library is high on the list. Whether you’re juggling coursework, gearing up for a busy spring, or simply craving a fresh start, the end of the year is the perfect moment to get your Mendeley library…Read more
Opens in a new window
How AI is Changing the Way Researchers WorkArtificial intelligence has arrived in the research workflow, and it’s moving fast. From literature discovery to manuscript drafting, tools powered…Read more
Opens in a new window
4 Study Tips to Help You Prepare for Exam SeasonAt the start of exam season, everything feels manageable. Then the reading lists grow, the notes multiply, and suddenly you’re spending more time searching for information than actually studying it. When your materials are easy to access, review, and use, revision becomes faster, more focused, and far less stressful. That’s where Mendeley can become your…Read more
